name: Molten Core: Ragnaros stays after killing Majordomo at the end of his summon intro
contract: Majordomo Executus summons Ragnaros (spell 19774) and Ragnaros kills him with Elemental Fire.
The boss summons cleanup that runs on a boss's death must not take Ragnaros with Majordomo:
Ragnaros still exists after his intro and 15s after becoming attackable.

steps.label: CONTROL: the hero is in Molten Core
CONTROL: Ragnaros does not exist yet
Spawn the friendly Majordomo and start the Ragnaros summon sequence
Let the summon sequence run up to Majordomo casting Elemental Fire and Ragnaros's DoAction(ACTION_FINISH_RAGNAROS_INTRO)
Ragnaros exists right after his intro is triggered to finish
Let EVENT_INTRO_SAY (5s) fire; EVENT_INTRO_MAKE_ATTACKABLE (2.5s more) has not fired yet
Ragnaros still exists right after EVENT_INTRO_SAY, before EVENT_INTRO_MAKE_ATTACKABLE
Ragnaros still exists right after EVENT_INTRO_MAKE_ATTACKABLE
A few more seconds past EVENT_INTRO_MAKE_ATTACKABLE
Ragnaros still exists a few seconds after EVENT_INTRO_MAKE_ATTACKABLE
Give any delayed evade/despawn path time to run
Ragnaros still exists 15s after becoming attackable
